title: 🎉 Eva Mala awarded a SoCoBio summer internship
summary: Eva Mala has been awarded a SoCoBio Summer Internship scholarship to work with the lab.
content: Congratulations to Eva Mala, who has been awarded a SoCoBio Summer Internship scholarship to work with the lab over the summer.

The SoCoBio Doctoral Training Partnership funds a small number of undergraduate internships each year, giving students a first taste of hands-on research before starting their own postgraduate journey.
Well deserved, Eva — looking forward to the summer's work!
